title: Refactor player-context: remove audio DOM management
acceptance_criteria: All state fields kept: active, autoPlay, isPlaying, isBuffering, queue, queueIndex, repeatMode
All action functions kept: playNext, skipNext, skipPrev, playTrack, playQueue
playTrack no longer calls resolveAndPlay — only sets state
skipNext/skipPrev no longer manage audio — only set state
Ref-based stable callbacks pattern preserved (queueRef, queueIndexRef, repeatModeRef)
Context stays pure state — no DOM or audio element manipulation
completion_summary: Refactored player-context: removed resolveAndPlay, gesturePlayPendingRef, consumeGesturePlay, registerAudioElement
